purpose: Public, versioned accounting of which daily-driver acceptance evidence is checked in and which release criteria remain unmeasured.

criteria.note: Checked-in sanitized AI-off fixture, exact pinned CLI revision, structural artifact, textual diff, and SHA-256 digests are validated offline.
A clean supported-environment CLI and packaged-extension install run with elapsed phases has not been recorded.
The fixture proves AI-off CLI artifact metadata only; direct BYOK and OpenAI-compatible/local-compatible provider outcomes are not recorded.
Missing CLI, schema mismatch, provider, timeout/cancellation, and parser/resolver recovery outcomes are not measured end to end.
Cold/warm history, graph-first-paint, structural-diff, cancellation, and cache measurements have not been published.
The released extension does not consume the structural JSON artifact, so packaged compatibility and schema-mismatch fallback remain unmeasured.
A static, no-network reviewer-task protocol is checked in, but no reviewer completion time, outcome, or failure points are published.
The website publishes static checked-in proof and explicitly distinguishes it from unmeasured end-to-end results.
CI validates synchronized public fixture, artifact, reviewer protocol, and release-truth evidence without secrets.
